subject: Risk & Compliance
title: NIST Cybersecurity Framework
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on NIST Cybersecurity Framework.

hook.text: How do you measure cybersecurity? You can't manage what you can't measure. That's NIST's starting point.

buildup.text: The NIST framework organizes cyber defense into five functions: Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, Recover.

discovery.text: Created in 2014, it became the most widely adopted cybersecurity framework in the world.

twist.text: NIST is voluntary for most industries. Companies adopt it because insurers and auditors demand it.

climax.text: NIST gives organizations a common language to discuss cyber risk — even if they can't eliminate it.

punchline.text: Five functions. One framework. The global standard.

quiz.question: What are the five NIST framework functions?
